about_the_game:
Take command of the AI Enhanced Squadron in the Aegis Carrier Fleet, the pinnacle of naval power where human skill merges with advanced AI control. As a naval pilot, you lead the most advanced aircraft into deadly battlezones, leading your squadrons of fighters, bombers, and drones to execute precision strikes against overwhelming enemy forces.

Your AI-assisted fleet IRRA (Integrated Reconnaissance and Response AI) adapts in real time, managing launches, traps, refueling, and armaments while learning from the battlefield to outmaneuver and outsmart your opponents. Every mission tests your strategy, reflexes, and leadership as you face heavily defended enemy positions, autonomous drone swarms, and mercenary fleets.

From storm-lashed seas to fortified coastlines, the Aegis Carrier Fleet puts you at the center of next-generation naval warfare. Every sortie shapes the battlefield, and every victory brings you closer to reclaiming the oceans from a relentless machine uprising. Precision, teamwork, and tactical mastery are your only path to survival—and triumph.

content_descriptors.notes: First person shooter type violence like call of duty.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i7-6700 or Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 6GB or Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i7-12700 or Ryzen 7 7800X3D
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060 SUPER or Radeon RX 5700 XT or Arc A770
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
